fields.value: Decode bencoding, read the info dictionary, interpret single-file or multi-file layout, and use piece hashes to verify payload chunks.

value.action: Read the .torrent byte stream and decode its bencoded top-level dictionary.
Read announce if present, plus optional extension fields such as announce-list, url-list, httpseeds, nodes, and private.
Read info.name and either info.length for a single file or info.files entries for a multi-file torrent.
Read piece length and split the logical content stream into pieces; multi-file v1 content follows files-list order.
Interpret pieces as concatenated 20-byte SHA-1 digests, one digest per piece.
Calculate the v1 infohash over the exact bencoded info dictionary and use it for torrent identity.
Use trackers and/or DHT to discover peers, fetch pieces, verify them, and assemble the payload.
